scene.speaker: astrid
scene.bubble: Fruit salad day! Apples, bananas, mango… we cut, we mix, we eat. The best lesson ever!
scene.intro: Fruit salad day! Astrid brings two apples and three bananas, and Freya brings one enormous watermelon that she can hardly carry. They cut the oranges, they mix the grapes and the strawberries, and the kitchen smells like summer. One mango, two mangoes, three mangoes — say them all! Which fruit do you like best? Bring it to the table and make the salad with them!

words.clue: Red or green. It is crunchy.
Long and yellow. Monkeys love it.
Small, green or purple, in a bunch.
A fruit with the name of a colour!

activities.title: Match the fruit with its colour.
Listen to the fruit salad. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Astrid: Fruit salad time! First, two red apples. … Freya: Cut! What next? … Astrid: Three bananas. Yellow and sweet. … Freya: Now the mango! It smells so good. … Astrid: And ten grapes. Purple ones. … Freya: Can we add strawberries? … Astrid: Yes! Five big strawberries. … Freya: Mix, mix, mix… ready! The salad has six colours! … Astrid: And one hungry bird watching. Hello, Pip!

activities.title: Quick check · Choose the correct word.

data.text: Fruit shop: Student A sells, Student B buys 3 fruits ("Two apples, please!"). Use please and thank you. Then swap.

activities.title: Spot the differences!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

activities.title: Exam part · Look at the picture. Write the word.
activities.instructions: The letters are not in order. Look at the picture and write the word.

homework.prompt: Draw a fruit salad with 5 fruits and label them. Write: My salad has…

outcomes.puede: Follow classroom instructions; identify familiar words in songs and short spoken sentences.
Greet; say name, age, colours; name objects; answer yes/no questions.
Recognise all 26 letters; match words to pictures (family, food, animals, body).
Write own name; trace and copy words; label pictures (3–5 words).
~150 productive words; Verb to be, can, like + noun, imperatives, this/that.
